scope: Known-Latin monoalphabetic control recovery; Voynich NOT_TRANSLATED; Kraken NOT_RETRAINED
blinding: Procedural separation in shared filesystem, not enforced security isolation. Root did not open hidden truth until freeze and evaluator authorization.
strict_positive_gate: PASS: three 2000-letter contents exactly recovered, including all 21 observed cipher assignments per content; five absent assignments nonidentifiable.
paired_presentations: Six presentations, three distinct contents; spaces ignored and identical streams cached. Not six independent recoveries; no word-boundary recovery.

execution.scope: Runtime metadata not part of deterministic predictions

audit.does_not_certify: Global optimality, security isolation, a historical decipherment, or unknown-language performance

nulls: No exact recovery; candidate language-model scores exceed true shuffled plaintext scores. No abstention threshold calibrated.
replay_scope: A deterministic computational replay after reveal, not a second blind trial.
sources: CLTK Latin Library pinned commit 76229acaf02efd1964ac32009408a90b6f279758; Public Domain Mark 1.0. Training Apicius1-5, held-out Caesar1-3.
